questions.q: What was counted to Abram for righteousness?
choices: He believed the Lord, and his faith showed itself in his works
questions.explain: It shall be our righteousness if we observe to do all these commandments (Deuteronomy 6:25).

questions.q: Where was the prophecy of Genesis 15:13 (a stranger in a land not theirs, four hundred years) fulfilled?
questions.explain: The sojourning of Israel in Egypt was four hundred and thirty years, and it ended the selfsame day (Exodus 12:40-41).

questions.q: How did Israel come out 'with great substance'?
choices: They found gold in the wilderness
They required silver, gold and raiment of the Egyptians and spoiled Egypt
They traded cattle along the way
questions.explain: The Lord gave the people favour, and they spoiled the Egyptians (Exodus 12:33-36).

questions.q: What was the deep sleep and horror of great darkness that fell on Abram?
choices: The sun had set on the sacrifice
He was about to receive a vision of future prophecy
questions.explain: In a dream, in a vision of the night, He openeth the ears of men (Job 33:15-16).
